parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The source of the scan task.

parameters.name: TaskName
parameters.description:
The name of the scan task. Valid values:

*   **CLIENT\_PROBLEM_CHECK**: a client diagnosis task
*   **CLIENT\_DEV_OPS**: an O\&M task of Cloud Assistant
*   **ASSET\_SECURITY_CHECK**: a task of asset information collection

parameters.name: TaskType
parameters.description:
The type of the scan task. Valid values:

*   **CLIENT\_PROBLEM_CHECK**: a client diagnosis task
*   **CLIENT\_DEV_OPS**: an O\&M task of Cloud Assistant
*   **ASSET\_SECURITY_CHECK**: a task of asset information collection

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas generate-once-task --task-type CLIENT_PROBLEM_CHECK --task-name CLIENT_PROBLEM_CHECK --param mode_:1,_problemType_:_offline_,_uuids_:_inet-795dcad1-360f-49d2-b01e-b7da7f1c0000 --source Manual --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
